description.hypothesis: "Fair value accounting" aims to measure and report on-going valuations of assets and liabilities. A recent increase in the fair value of liabilities may indicate a higher cost to be borne by the company in the future. This may deteriorate the company's financial health, potentially leading to lower profitability or financial distress.
description.implementation: Using ts_rank() operator, sell stocks when there is an increase in the fair value of liabilities within a year using fundamental data.
